easy: The time when something ends.

ex.en: The bell rang at the finish of the game.
ex.ko: 경기가 끝날 때 종이 울렸다.

easy: Bigger or more than before.

ex.en: The increased noise made the baby cry.
ex.ko: 커진 소음 때문에 아기가 울었다.

easy: From the country of India.

ex.en: My friend brings Indian food for lunch.
ex.ko: 내 친구는 점심으로 인도 음식을 가져온다.

easy: A person from India.

ex.en: An Indian girl in my class taught us a dance.
ex.ko: 우리 반 인도 여자아이가 우리에게 춤을 가르쳐 주었다.

easy: Exactly as the words say, with no tricks.

ex.en: She translated the word literally.
ex.ko: 그녀는 그 단어를 글자 그대로 번역했다.

easy: Really and truly, not just a way of talking.

ex.en: I was literally standing in the rain for an hour.
ex.ko: 나는 정말로 한 시간 동안 빗속에 서 있었다.

easy: Good things that happen by chance, not because you planned them.

ex.en: It was pure luck that I found my lost sock.
ex.ko: 잃어버린 양말을 찾은 건 순전히 운이었다.

easy: Being husband and wife.

ex.en: My grandparents have a long and happy marriage.
ex.ko: 우리 조부모님은 길고 행복한 결혼 생활을 하셨다.

easy: The special event where two people become husband and wife.

ex.en: Their marriage took place in a garden.
ex.ko: 그들의 결혼식은 정원에서 열렸다.

easy: Something you must have; you cannot do without it.

ex.en: Water is necessary for plants to grow.
ex.ko: 식물이 자라려면 물이 필요하다.

easy: Having lots of money.

ex.en: The rich man bought a huge house with a pool.
ex.ko: 그 부자는 수영장이 있는 큰 집을 샀다.

easy: Having plenty of something good.

ex.en: This soil is rich in minerals, so plants grow well.
ex.ko: 이 흙은 미네랄이 풍부해서 식물이 잘 자란다.

easy: The soft outer covering of your body.

ex.en: Put on sunscreen to protect your skin.
ex.ko: 피부를 보호하려면 자외선 차단제를 발라라.

easy: The outer covering of an animal's body.

ex.en: A snake's skin is dry and covered with scales.
ex.ko: 뱀의 가죽은 건조하고 비늘로 덮여 있다.

easy: Able to talk.

ex.en: Our speaking parrot says hello every morning.
ex.ko: 우리 말하는 앵무새는 매일 아침 인사한다.

easy: Talking out loud to people.

ex.en: I am nervous about speaking in front of the class.
ex.ko: 나는 반 친구들 앞에서 말하는 것이 긴장된다.

easy: Expected or told to do something.

ex.en: I am supposed to feed the dog after school.
ex.ko: 나는 방과 후에 개에게 밥을 주기로 되어 있다.

easy: Tasting like sugar.

ex.en: The strawberries were sweet.
ex.ko: 딸기가 달콤했다.

easy: Kind and gentle, like a little angel.

ex.en: The baby gave us a sweet smile.
ex.ko: 아기가 우리에게 사랑스러운 미소를 지었다.

easy: Nice and pleasant to hear.

ex.en: The bird had a sweet song.
ex.ko: 그 새는 듣기 좋은 노래를 불렀다.

easy: For that reason; because of what was just said.

ex.en: It rained all day, thus we played inside.
ex.ko: 하루 종일 비가 와서 우리는 안에서 놀았다.

easy: In this way.

ex.en: Hold the brush thus, with your thumb on top.
ex.ko: 붓을 이렇게, 엄지를 위에 두고 잡아라.

easy: To put your hand or finger on something.

ex.en: Please do not touch the hot stove.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 가스레인지를 만지지 마세요.

easy: To make someone feel love or sadness inside.

ex.en: The sad story touched everyone in my class.
ex.ko: 그 슬픈 이야기는 우리 반 모두를 감동시켰다.

easy: The day before today.

ex.en: Yesterday I lost my first tooth.
ex.ko: 어제 나는 처음으로 이가 빠졌다.

easy: On the day before today.

ex.en: We went to the zoo yesterday.
ex.ko: 우리는 어제 동물원에 갔다.

easy: Not open, so you cannot go through.

ex.en: The road was closed because of the snow.
ex.ko: 눈 때문에 도로가 폐쇄되었다.

easy: Not open.

ex.en: Please keep the window closed; it is cold.
ex.ko: 추우니까 창문을 닫아 두세요.

easy: Harm that makes something worse or broken.

ex.en: The storm did a lot of damage to our fence.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 우리 울타리에 큰 피해를 입혔다.

easy: In a straight line, with no stops or turns.

ex.en: Go directly home after school.
ex.ko: 방과 후에 곧장 집으로 가라.

easy: With nothing or no one in between.

ex.en: I talked directly to the teacher.
ex.ko: 나는 선생님께 직접 말씀드렸다.

easy: Right away, with no waiting.

ex.en: I came directly when Mom called.
ex.ko: 엄마가 부르자 나는 곧바로 갔다.

easy: An illness that makes a body not work well.

ex.en: Washing your hands helps stop disease from spreading.
ex.ko: 손을 씻으면 병이 퍼지는 것을 막을 수 있다.

easy: A person who helps sick people get better.

ex.en: The doctor looked at my sore throat.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님이 내 아픈 목을 살펴보았다.

easy: A feeling of not being sure.

ex.en: I have no doubt that our team will win.
ex.ko: 나는 우리 팀이 이길 것을 조금도 의심하지 않는다.

easy: To think something is probably not true.

ex.en: I doubt it will snow in July.
ex.ko: 나는 7월에 눈이 올 것 같지 않다고 생각한다.

easy: A cup or glass of something to sip.

ex.en: Can I have a cold drink, please?
ex.ko: 시원한 음료수 좀 주시겠어요?

easy: Any liquid that you can swallow, like milk or juice.

ex.en: Water is the best drink on a hot day.
ex.ko: 더운 날에는 물이 가장 좋은 마실 것이다.

easy: Set up long ago and accepted by many people.

ex.en: The school has an established rule: no running in the hall.
ex.ko: 학교에는 복도에서 뛰지 않는다는 확립된 규칙이 있다.

easy: An animal that lives in water and swims with fins.

ex.en: We saw a big orange fish in the pond.
ex.ko: 우리는 연못에서 커다란 주황색 물고기를 보았다.

easy: The meat of a sea or river animal that we eat.

ex.en: We had grilled fish for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 구운 생선을 먹었다.

easy: Happy about something.

ex.en: I am glad you came to my party.
ex.ko: 네가 내 생일 파티에 와서 기쁘다.

easy: Bigger or more important.

ex.en: A whale is much greater in size than a dolphin.
ex.ko: 고래는 돌고래보다 훨씬 더 크다.

easy: To slowly change into something else.

ex.en: The sky grew dark before the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 오기 전에 하늘이 어두워졌다.

easy: To get bigger.

ex.en: The puppy grows bigger every week.
ex.ko: 강아지는 매주 더 커진다.

easy: To get bigger, like a plant or a child does.

ex.en: Tomatoes grow well in our garden.
ex.ko: 우리 정원에서는 토마토가 잘 자란다.

easy: A thing with parts that works to help people do a job.

ex.en: The washing machine cleans our dirty clothes.
ex.ko: 세탁기가 우리의 더러운 옷을 빨아 준다.

easy: A sign or paper that tells people about something.

ex.en: There is a notice about the school picnic on the door.
ex.ko: 문에 학교 소풍에 대한 공지가 붙어 있다.

easy: Looking at something and paying attention to it.

ex.en: The dog barked to get our notice.
ex.ko: 개가 우리의 주의를 끌려고 짖었다.

easy: Counting everything together.

ex.en: The overall cost of the trip was fifty dollars.
ex.ko: 여행의 전체 비용은 50달러였다.

easy: Pants with a top part that goes over your shoulders.

ex.en: My little brother wears overalls on the farm.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 농장에서 멜빵바지를 입는다.

easy: Thinking about what to do and how to do it before you start.

ex.en: Planning our camping trip was so much fun.
ex.ko: 캠핑 여행 계획을 세우는 것은 정말 즐거웠다.

easy: A teacher at a college or university.

ex.en: My uncle is a professor at a big university.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 큰 대학교의 교수님이다.

easy: To rest on your bottom with your back straight.

ex.en: Please sit on the carpet for story time.
ex.ko: 이야기 시간에는 카펫에 앉으세요.

easy: To stay in a place without moving or doing much.

ex.en: The old bike sat in the garage all winter.
ex.ko: 낡은 자전거가 겨울 내내 차고에 놓여 있었다.

easy: To lower yourself onto a chair.

ex.en: Sit down and eat your breakfast.
ex.ko: 앉아서 아침을 먹어라.

easy: Going somewhere and coming back.

ex.en: We took a trip to the beach last summer.
ex.ko: 우리는 지난여름 해변으로 여행을 갔다.

easy: A stumble when your foot hits something.

ex.en: A trip on the stairs made me drop my books.
ex.ko: 계단에서 걸려 넘어져서 책을 떨어뜨렸다.

easy: The simplest and most important part that other things are built on.

ex.en: Learning the alphabet is a basic skill.
ex.ko: 알파벳을 배우는 것은 기본 기술이다.

easy: Made for people who are just starting to learn.

ex.en: I signed up for a basic swimming class.
ex.ko: 나는 기초 수영 수업에 등록했다.

easy: The person in charge of a ship.

ex.en: The captain steered the ship through the storm.
ex.ko: 선장은 폭풍 속에서 배를 몰았다.

easy: To hold something and take it to another place.

ex.en: I carry my backpack to school every day.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 책가방을 메고 학교에 간다.

easy: To have something with you, like in your bag or pocket.

ex.en: Mom always carries a water bottle in her bag.
ex.ko: 엄마는 항상 가방에 물병을 가지고 다닌다.

easy: To let sound or signals travel.

ex.en: Sound carries far across a quiet lake.
ex.ko: 소리는 조용한 호수 위로 멀리 전달된다.

easy: Something bad that breaks the law.

ex.en: Stealing a bike is a crime.
ex.ko: 자전거를 훔치는 것은 범죄이다.

easy: Completely; all the way.

ex.en: The baby bird is fully grown now.
ex.ko: 아기 새는 이제 완전히 자랐다.

easy: Very much; to a great amount.

ex.en: My coach is highly skilled at soccer.
ex.ko: 우리 코치님은 축구를 매우 잘하신다.

easy: A boy or man, or an animal of the kind that does not have babies.

ex.en: The male lion has a big mane.
ex.ko: 수사자는 큰 갈기를 가지고 있다.

easy: Like or typical of a man.

ex.en: Dad has a deep male voice.
ex.ko: 아빠는 낮고 굵은 남자 목소리를 가졌다.

easy: Meant for boys or men.

ex.en: He is the male lead in the school play.
ex.ko: 그는 학교 연극에서 남자 주인공이다.

easy: A title put before the name of a married woman.

ex.en: Mrs. Lee is my favorite teacher.
ex.ko: 이 선생님은 내가 가장 좋아하는 선생님이다.

easy: To put seeds into the ground so they will grow.

ex.en: We plant sunflower seeds in the spring.
ex.ko: 우리는 봄에 해바라기 씨앗을 심는다.

easy: What is real; the way things truly are.

ex.en: Dragons are not part of reality.
ex.ko: 용은 현실에 존재하지 않는다.

easy: How things really are, not how you wish they were.

ex.en: The reality is that we cannot go out in this storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍 속에 나갈 수 없다는 것이 현실이다.

easy: A person who makes things from hot metal by hitting it with a hammer.

ex.en: The smith hammered the hot iron into a horseshoe.
ex.ko: 대장장이는 뜨거운 쇠를 망치로 두드려 말굽을 만들었다.

easy: The coldest time of the year.

ex.en: We build a snowman every winter.
ex.ko: 우리는 겨울마다 눈사람을 만든다.

easy: To stay somewhere during the coldest time of the year.

ex.en: Many birds winter in warm places.
ex.ko: 많은 새들이 따뜻한 곳에서 겨울을 난다.

easy: More bad than something else.

ex.en: Today's weather is worse than yesterday's.
ex.ko: 오늘 날씨는 어제보다 더 나쁘다.

easy: More sick than before.

ex.en: My cold feels worse today.
ex.ko: 오늘은 감기가 더 심해진 것 같다.

easy: Ideas you tell someone to help them decide what to do.

ex.en: My grandma gave me good advice about making friends.
ex.ko: 할머니는 친구 사귀는 법에 대해 좋은 조언을 해 주셨다.

easy: A promise between people about what they will do.

ex.en: We made an agreement to share the video game.
ex.ko: 우리는 비디오 게임을 같이 하기로 합의했다.

easy: When people think the same way and do not fight.

ex.en: The whole class was in agreement about the pizza party.
ex.ko: 반 전체가 피자 파티에 대해 의견이 같았다.

easy: A prize or medal that shows someone did something great.

ex.en: I got an award for reading the most books.
ex.ko: 나는 책을 가장 많이 읽어서 상을 받았다.

easy: Something you win for being the best.

ex.en: The winner's award was a shiny trophy.
ex.ko: 우승자의 상은 반짝이는 트로피였다.

easy: To put something in the way so no one can pass.

ex.en: A fallen tree blocked the road.
ex.ko: 쓰러진 나무가 길을 막았다.

easy: To get in the way so someone cannot go on.

ex.en: The big dog blocked me from getting to the door.
ex.ko: 큰 개가 내가 문까지 가지 못하게 막았다.

easy: Cracked or in pieces.

ex.en: Be careful of the broken glass on the floor.
ex.ko: 바닥에 깨진 유리를 조심해라.

easy: Something you say or write to share what you think.

ex.en: She made a nice comment about my drawing.
ex.ko: 그녀는 내 그림에 대해 좋은 말을 해 주었다.

easy: The tools and things you need for a job or a game.

ex.en: Put the sports equipment back in the gym closet.
ex.ko: 운동 장비를 체육관 창고에 다시 넣어라.

easy: Connected to God or a religion in a very special way.

ex.en: The people believe the old temple is a holy place.
ex.ko: 사람들은 그 오래된 사원이 신성한 곳이라고 믿는다.

easy: A large number or amount.

ex.en: I made lots of new friends at camp.
ex.ko: 나는 캠프에서 많은 새 친구를 사귀었다.

easy: Very much.

ex.en: I feel a lot better after resting.
ex.ko: 쉬고 나니 훨씬 나아졌다.

easy: The most important; first in importance.

ex.en: Our primary goal is to win the game.
ex.ko: 우리의 주된 목표는 경기에서 이기는 것이다.

easy: To go to stores to buy things.

ex.en: We shop for school supplies every August.
ex.ko: 우리는 매년 8월에 학용품을 사러 간다.

easy: A time when a movie is shown to people.

ex.en: The first showing of the movie starts at noon.
ex.ko: 그 영화의 첫 상영은 정오에 시작한다.

easy: Not healthy; having an illness.

ex.en: I stayed home from school because I was sick.
ex.ko: 나는 아파서 학교에 가지 않고 집에 있었다.

easy: Feeling like you might throw up.

ex.en: The bumpy bus ride made me feel sick.
ex.ko: 덜컹거리는 버스 때문에 속이 메스꺼웠다.

easy: A person whose job is to help students learn.

ex.en: My teacher reads us a story every day.
ex.ko: 우리 선생님은 매일 이야기를 읽어 주신다.

easy: An idea that explains how something in nature works, backed up by many tests.

ex.en: Scientists use the theory of gravity to explain why things fall.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 중력 이론으로 물건이 왜 떨어지는지 설명한다.

easy: A company that helps people with a certain job.

ex.en: Mom booked our flight through a travel agency.
ex.ko: 엄마는 여행사를 통해 비행기표를 예약했다.

easy: To stay away from someone or something.

ex.en: I avoid the puddles on my way to school.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 가는 길에 물웅덩이를 피한다.

easy: To stop something bad from happening.

ex.en: Wear a helmet to avoid getting hurt.
ex.ko: 다치지 않도록 헬멧을 써라.

easy: To not do something on purpose.

ex.en: Try to avoid eating too much candy.
ex.ko: 사탕을 너무 많이 먹는 것을 삼가도록 노력해라.

easy: A tool that takes pictures.

ex.en: I took a photo of my dog with Dad's camera.
ex.ko: 나는 아빠 카메라로 우리 개 사진을 찍었다.

easy: A machine that records moving pictures for TV.

ex.en: The TV camera followed the runners.
ex.ko: 방송용 카메라가 달리는 선수들을 따라갔다.

easy: Medicine that helps your body get better.

ex.en: The doctor gave me a drug to stop my cough.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님이 기침을 멎게 하는 약을 주셨다.

easy: A long space inside a building with doors to rooms.

ex.en: Do not run in the hall at school.
ex.ko: 학교 복도에서 뛰지 마라.

easy: A big room near the front door of a building.

ex.en: We waited for Mom in the big hall of the museum.
ex.ko: 우리는 박물관의 큰 로비에서 엄마를 기다렸다.
